title: Installing CyberArk PAM Self-Hosted
content:
This guide covers the installation of CyberArk Privileged Access Manager (PAM) Self-Hosted components including the Digital Vault, PVWA, CPM, and PSM.

## System Requirements

### Digital Vault Server
- Windows Server 2019 or 2022
- 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended)
- 100 GB disk space
- Dedicated server (no other applications)
- Static IP address

### PVWA Server
- Windows Server 2019 or 2022
- IIS 10.0 with ASP.NET 4.8
- 8 GB RAM minimum
- .NET Framework 4.8

### CPM Server
- Windows Server 2019 or 2022
- 4 GB RAM minimum
- Network access to managed target systems

### PSM Server
- Windows Server 2019 or 2022
- 8 GB RAM minimum (more for concurrent sessions)
- Remote Desktop Services role installed

## Installation Order

Install components in this order:
1. Digital Vault
2. PVWA
3. CPM
4. PSM
5. Privileged Threat Analytics (optional)

## Installing the Digital Vault

Step 1: Run the Vault installation wizard:
```
Setup.exe /s /v"INSTALLDIR=C:\CyberArk\Vault"
```

Step 2: Configure the Vault:
- Set the Vault name and description
- Configure the Master password (store securely)
- Set the DR user password
- Configure network settings (port 1858 by default)

Step 3: Initialize the Vault:
```
CAVaultManager.exe InitializeVault /SafesPath:C:\CyberArk\Vault\Safes
```

Step 4: Start the CyberArk Vault service and verify it is running.

## Installing PVWA

Step 1: Ensure IIS prerequisites are installed:
```powershell
Install-WindowsFeature Web-Server, Web-Asp-Net45, Web-Mgmt-Console
```

Step 2: Run the PVWA installation:
```
PVWA_Setup.exe /s
```

Step 3: Configure the PVWA to connect to the Vault:
- Vault IP address and port
- Authentication credentials
- Application pool identity

Step 4: Verify PVWA is accessible at https://<server>/PasswordVault

## Post-Installation Tasks

### Configure Hardening

CyberArk provides hardening scripts for each component:

```powershell
# Vault hardening
.\VaultHardening.ps1 -VaultPath C:\CyberArk\Vault

# PVWA hardening
.\PVWAHardening.ps1

# CPM hardening
.\CPMHardening.ps1
```

### Configure Disaster Recovery

1. Install a secondary Vault server
2. Configure replication between primary and DR Vault
3. Set up automatic failover
4. Test failover procedure quarterly

### Enable Audit Logging

Configure syslog forwarding for SIEM integration:
```
VaultINI.ini:
[SYSLOG]
SyslogServerIP=siem.example.com
SyslogServerPort=514
SyslogProtocol=TCP
```

## Upgrading

To upgrade PAM Self-Hosted:
1. Back up the Vault data and configuration
2. Stop all CyberArk services
3. Run the upgrade installer for each component in order
4. Verify all services start correctly
5. Test PVWA, CPM, and PSM functionality
